entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David with VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi, David. I... I'm calling because I need to return something. I ordered a new helmet, and I'm just so disappointed.
I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into this for you. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Of course. The name is Maria Garcia, order number VF-98221. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I've never had to return anything before. This is just... really upsetting.

Thank you, Maria. I'm pulling that up now... Yes, I see you're one of our long-time VIP members. We truly appreciate your business. I see the order here for the Aero-Shield helmet. What specifically is the issue with it? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's just the color. On the website, it looked like a matte black, but it's more of a glossy gray. It doesn't match my bike at all. I know it sounds trivial, but I saved up for it, and I can't even bring myself to take it out of the packaging. The box is completely unopened.

Not at all, Maria, I completely understand. Having gear you feel good in is a huge part of performance and even safety. You need to be confident. Let me just confirm the return eligibility for you. One moment.
Okay, thank you. I was so worried I'd be stuck with it, and with money being so tight, I really needed that back if it wasn't right.
Alright, I've checked the policy. The helmet was delivered just 8 days ago, so you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process this return for a full refund for you right now.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! Thank you, David. I was so stressed about this.

It's my pleasure. And Maria, as a thank you for being such a loyal VIP member, I'm going to email you a pre-paid return label, so you won't have to pay for shipping. I've also added a 10% discount coupon to your account for your next purchase, in case you find another helmet or some other gear in a color you prefer.
Wow, that's incredibly generous. You've completely turned this around for me. Thank you so much!

You are very welcome. The email with the label should be in your inbox shortly. Just attach it to the box and drop it at any shipping center. Once we receive it, your refund will be issued. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
No, that's perfect. Thank you again, David.
Happy to help. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
